articles.title: Oil Analysts Have Raised Their 2026 Forecasts for the Third Time. The Era of $60 Brent May Be Over.
articles.excerpt: Brent is now forecast to average $90.44 a barrel this year, up 40 per cent from February estimates. Middle East crude exports have halved. Even a ceasefire will not undo the structural damage quickly. Here is what NRI investors should understand.
articles.nri_angle: For NRIs with India exposure through mutual funds, NRE/NRO deposits, or direct equity holdings, elevated oil prices are the single biggest macro variable. A weaker rupee erodes dollar-denominated returns on Indian assets, remittances buy less due to fuel-driven domestic inflation, and rate-sensitive sectors face headwinds if the RBI is forced to hike.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: US Inflation Just Hit 3.8 Per Cent. Markets Are Now Pricing a Fed Rate Hike Over a Cut. Here Is What That Means for NRI Investors.
articles.excerpt: The April PCE reading is the highest since May 2023. The S&P 500 has risen for nine straight weeks anyway. On June 5, both the US jobs report and the RBI rate decision land on the same day. Your portfolio in both countries is on the line.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Just Raised Gold Import Duty to 15 Per Cent. Demand Has Collapsed, Discounts Hit $106 an Ounce, and Jewellers Are Refusing to Stock Up.
articles.excerpt: The duty hike from 6 to 15 per cent — the steepest in a decade — has frozen India's gold market. Retail footfall has cratered, dealers are quoting record discounts, and NRIs planning weddings or gifts face a significant cost increase.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: The US Just Dropped Fraud Charges Against Gautam Adani. His Stock Surged 22 Per Cent in May. Here Is What NRI Investors Should Understand About What Happened.
